description:
Create a file session for uploading proof/artwork files. Returns a **fileSessionId**. Once it is joined to a configuration session, add_to_cart attaches its files without you passing the ID.

**Two workflows:**
- **File-first** (no product chosen yet): call with no arguments. A placeholder product is used. When the product is chosen, you MUST pass this fileSessionId to create_config_session (or call link_file_session): nothing joins them otherwise, and the configuration has no files. The real product is then reconciled automatically.
- **Config-first** (configuration session already exists): pass productConfigSessionId (and ideally the productId). The file session is created and linked immediately, so add_to_cart needs only the configuration sessionId.

Once joined, the link is persisted server-side, so later tools (add_to_cart) need only the configuration sessionId.

productConfigSessionId.description: Existing configuration session ID to link this file session to immediately (config-first).

productId.description: Product ID, e.g. "SLS_7". Omit for file-first; a placeholder is used until a product is chosen.

name: create_file_session
